title: NorthPoint Solar onramp scratchbook
body:
Context:
- Customer: NorthPoint Solar (regional solar farm operator, mid-size, multi-site)
- Kickoff call 2024-09-25; this is my working scratchbook for follow-ups and gotchas. Not polished; for internal use.

Attendees (call):
- Maya Patel (Redwood CS)
- Jonah Kim (Redwood Solutions Eng)
- Priya Desai (Redwood SRE liaison)
- Claire Hsu (NorthPoint CTO)
- Mateo Alvarez (NorthPoint Lead Ops)

Summary / goals:
- Onboard NorthPoint to a private Redwood deployment inside their AWS VPC for a field diagnostics assistant (alerts triage, log summarization, operator Q&A).
- Primary constraints: offline-friendly (intermittent connectivity), strict data residency (no offsite logs), KMS-managed keys, must support canary rollouts across three geographic sites.
- Target pilot: 3 sites, 2 reserved inference nodes per site, 99th-percentile latency target < 250ms for short Q&A paths (50–200 tokens), throughput ~100 concurrent requests/day initially.

Immediate technical notes / requirements captured:
- Networking: customer prefers private deployment with a VPC peering model rather than Transit Gateway for cost reasons. They will provide a dedicated subnet per site and a NAT for optional updates.
- Egress: Zero egress to public internet for request payloads; control plane needs limited egress for agent updates (allowed list will be provided).
- KMS: NorthPoint uses AWS KMS with custom policies; require envelope encryption and a key rotation plan. Need SRE to confirm that Redwood Private supports AWS KMS CMKs in their account (task Jonah).
- Air-gapped fallback: For sites with months-long offline windows, propose a lightweight on-prem inference package (container bundle) that can run in air-gapped mode with periodic model sync windows. Customer asked for an offline plan; we sketched staged sync windows during maintenance.

Policy / compliance notes:
- Logging: They need R/O audit logs retained for 2 years. Must confirm retention + export hooks; likely will route logs to their S3 bucket with lifecycle policy.
- PII: telemetry payloads may include serial numbers and technician notes; need field mapping & prompt scrubbing guidance from Product (ask Product for recommended scrub template).

Deployment/Model choices discussed:
- Models: Start with a mid-size open family (13B-ish) for latency/cost balance. If quantized 4-bit on A100-style nodes, should meet latency target.
- Canary strategy: roll out model variant per-site with traffic split (10% -> canary) for 72 hours, auto-rollback if error rate > 1% or latency regression > 30% from baseline. Product/Console supports this; show demo.

Gotchas and risks (from call):
- Intermittent connectivity will break streaming responses and KV-cache prefetch. Need a fallback: short polling + resumable generation tokens OR pre-warm caches before site loses connectivity.
- Their ops team runs older Kubernetes (1.19) on some edge clusters; Redwood Private requires kube >= 1.22 for the operator. Edge nodes will need upgrading or we provide VM/container alternative.
- Encryption policy: they restrict inbound packages to signed artifacts only (SBOM + signature). Our on-prem bundle must include signing manifest.

Quick local test notes we ran post-call:
- Lightweight perf run (simulated): 13B quantized on a single g4dn.xlarge equiv: avg latency 190ms for 64-token responses (cold), 80ms warm. These are synthetic — need real infra.
- Small script used: curl -X POST https://private.local/run -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"prompt":"Diagnose inverter error P34"}' (just a placeholder — do not commit token).

Open questions (actionable):
- Q1: Can Redwood Private's control plane be configured with a restricted egress allowlist? (Owner: Priya -> follow up 2024-10-07)
- Q2: Does the private bundle include signed SBOMs by default or do we need to add a signing step for NorthPoint? (Owner: Jonah -> check release-engineering, target 2024-10-09)
- Q3: For long offline windows, what is the recommended KV cache pre-population process? Product should provide a small runbook. (Owner: Maya -> request runbook from Product, target 2024-10-11)

Action items / next steps:
- Jonah: Confirm KMS CMK support and provide a short doc on required IAM policies (due 2024-10-09).
- Priya: Validate control-plane egress allowlist feasibility and ask infra about proxy recommendations (due 2024-10-07).
- Maya: Draft field-scrubbing prompt templates to reduce PII leakage and circulate (due 2024-10-11).
- Claire (NorthPoint): Share subnet CIDR blocks and security contact; schedule infra inventory call for 2024-10-08.

Notes to self / scratch ideas:
- Consider shipping a minimal on-device model (distilled small) for the most remote site as temporary patch; can act as a local Q/A fallback with eventual sync to private cluster.
- Create a checklist for edge clusters: kube version, available GPU count, trusted signing CA, network ACLs, S3 endpoint config.

References and links (internal):
- Confluence draft: confluence:NP-Solar-onramp-2024 (internal sketch with network diagrams)
- Jira ticket: CS-1174 (NorthPoint onramp epic)
- PR: github:np-solar/provisioning#22 (initial infra scripts)

End of scratchbook entry. Will convert into a cleaner onboarding brief once open questions answered.
